content.title: THE MINERAL YOUR THYROID CAN'T FUNCTION WITHOUT
facts: **Selenium** (Hormone Converter) — Brazil Nuts | Sardines | Sunflower Seeds | Turkey
**Zinc** (Immune Trigger) — Pumpkin Seeds | Oysters | Lentils | Cashews
**Potassium** (Nerve Signal Sender) — Bananas | White Beans | Coconut Water | Spinach
**Magnesium** (Muscle Relaxer) — Pumpkin Seeds | Dark Chocolate | Avocado | Almonds
**Iron** (Oxygen Carrier) — Lentils | Pumpkin Seeds | Spinach | Red Meat
**Follow along** – for more daily health tips like this.
content.caption:
Your thyroid runs almost entirely on **iodine** — without enough of it, your body can't produce the hormones that control your metabolism, so even small deficiencies can leave you feeling sluggish or foggy. **Selenium** works right alongside it, helping convert the thyroid's raw hormone into the active form your cells actually use — think of it as the key that unlocks iodine's work. And don't sleep on **zinc**: it's involved in over 300 enzyme reactions, including the ones your immune system uses to fight off invaders before you even notice you're sick. Everyone's body is different, listen to yours.

At @smarthealthfix, we break down nutrition, common health issues, organs & body functions, and small daily habits so health feels less overwhelming. Our mission is to help you build small, realistic habits instead of chasing quick fixes.
